title: Categories keeps its sort after a category is created, edited or deleted
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC30 alpha) exists.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC30 Beta) exists.
  • Category {Category-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC30 tier 9) exists.
  • No category named {Category-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC30 gamma) exists yet. The test creates it.
  • No category named {Category-E} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC30 Delta) exists yet. The test renames {Category-B} to it.
  • You are on a page other than Categories, so the list opens sorted by Name A to Z.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the Name column header once, so the list is Z to A.
  3. Click New Category.
  4. Type {Category-D} as the name.
  5. Save the dialog.
  6. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  7. Read the Name header arrow and the order of the tagged categories.
  8. Open {Category-B} for editing.
  9. Change its name to {Category-E}.
  10. Save the dialog.
  11. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  12. Read the Name header arrow and the order of the tagged categories.
  13. Delete {Category-C}.
  14. Confirm the deletion.
  15. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  16. Read the Name header arrow and the order of the tagged categories.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: the Name header arrow still points down and the rows read {Category-C}, {Category-D}, {Category-B}, {Category-A} (tier 9, gamma, Beta, alpha), Z to A.
  • Step 12: the arrow still points down and the rows read {Category-C}, {Category-D}, {Category-E}, {Category-A} (tier 9, gamma, Delta, alpha). The renamed row has moved to its new place in the Z to A order.
  • Step 16: the arrow still points down and the rows read {Category-D}, {Category-E}, {Category-A} (gamma, Delta, alpha). The list did not go back to A to Z.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R15 and the Story 1 context note, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The three rules that bite), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Key Decision 'A sort belongs to the user until they leave the page'. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R15: “When the list reloads in place, the sort the user chose stays applied, in the same direction, and the header arrow stays where it was.”
  • PRD Story 1 context note: “The list reloads when a dialog that creates, edits or deletes a category closes. That is a reload in place, so S1-R15 applies and the sort survives it.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions: “Creating, editing or deleting a row reloads the list in place and the sort stays as the user set it; so does typing a search term, which refetches the matching rows and presents them in that same order.”
